          <th scope=\"row\"><b>Description: </b></th>\n            <td style=\"padding-left: 4px;\"><div><p>Spørgeskematriagering triagerer besvarelserne i et spørgeskema. Således giver én rød besvarelse rød triagering, og hvis der ingen røde besvarelser er, men mindst en gul besvarelse, bliver triageringsfarven gul.        <td colspan=\"2\">\n            <table>\n              <tr><th><b>Content: </b> text/plain</th></tr>\n              <tr><td><pre><code>package rules\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.QuestionnaireResponse\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Questionnaire\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.ServiceRequest\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.context.SimpleWorkerContext\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Coding\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Type\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.ClinicalImpressionDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.AnswerSignificanceDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.TaskDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.CommunicationDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.CodingDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.exception.MismatchedInputException\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.extensions.EHealthQuestionnaireItemComponentExtension\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.util.QuestionnaireUtility\r\nimport java.util.ArrayList\r\nimport java.util.Collection\r\nimport java.util.List\r\nimport java.util.Collections\r\nimport org.apache.commons.collections4.MultiValuedMap\r\nimport org.apache.commons.collections4.multimap.ArrayListValuedHashMap;\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.extensions.EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension\r\nimport java.util.Map\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.BooleanType\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.extensions.EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerConditionExtension\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.DecimalType\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.IntegerType\r\nimport org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.StringType\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.AnswerConditionDTO\r\nimport com.systematic.ehealth.exception.RuleExecutionException\r\n\r\n\r\nglobal com.systematic.ehealth.automatedprocessing.AutomatedProcessingDTO ruleResult\r\n\r\n\r\nfunction String getPriorityFromClinicalFinding(CodingDTO clinicalImpressionFinding) {\r\n    switch (clinicalImpressionFinding.getCode()) {\r\n        case &quot;no-answer-significance-defined&quot;:\r\n        case &quot;no-effective-answer-significance&quot;:\r\n        case &quot;green&quot;:\r\n            return &quot;routine&quot;;\r\n        case &quot;yellow&quot;:\r\n            return &quot;urgent&quot;;\r\n        case &quot;red&quot;:\r\n            return &quot;asap&quot;;\r\n        default:\r\n            return null;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction CodingDTO getClinicalImpressionFinding(List findingBasisList) {\r\n    if (findingBasisList.isEmpty()) {\r\n        //Answer significances found, but answers didn't match\r\n        return new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes&quot;, &quot;no-effective-answer-significance&quot;, &quot;no effective answer significance for answer and question combination&quot;);\r\n    }\r\n    boolean yellowAnswerFound = false;\r\n\r\n    for (Object findingBasis : findingBasisList) {\r\n        QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO findingBasisDTO = (QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO) findingBasis;\r\n        String significanceCode = findingBasisDTO.getFinding().getCode();\r\n        if (significanceCode.equals(&quot;red-question-answer&quot;)) {\r\n            //Return early when red question answer is found\r\n            return new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes&quot;, &quot;red&quot;, &quot;Red overall assessment&quot;);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (significanceCode.equals(&quot;yellow-question-answer&quot;)) {\r\n            yellowAnswerFound = true;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (yellowAnswerFound) {\r\n        //Can assume we have returned if red question answer was found\r\n        return new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes&quot;, &quot;yellow&quot;, &quot;Yellow overall assessment&quot;);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //Can assume only green findings, since its not empty, red or yellow.\r\n    //No answer significances, is handled before this function\r\n\r\n    return new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes&quot;, &quot;green&quot;, &quot;Green overall assessment&quot;);\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction boolean containsExistsFalseCondition(EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension answerSignificance) {\r\n    for (EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerConditionExtension condition : answerSignificance.getAnswerConditions()) {\r\n        if (condition.getOperator().hasCode() &amp;&amp;\r\n            condition.getOperator().getCode().equals(&quot;exists&quot;) &amp;&amp;\r\n            condition.getValue() instanceof BooleanType &amp;&amp;\r\n            !((BooleanType) condition.getValue()).booleanValue()) {\r\n            return true;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    return false;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction AnswerSignificanceDTO createAnswerSignificanceFromExtension(EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension extension) {\r\n    AnswerSignificanceDTO dto = new AnswerSignificanceDTO();\r\n    dto.setSignificance(new CodingDTO(extension.getSignificance().getSystem(), extension.getSignificance().getCode(), extension.getSignificance().getDisplay()));\r\n    List&lt;AnswerConditionDTO&gt; conditionDTOs = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();\r\n    for (EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerConditionExtension condition :  extension.getAnswerConditions()) {\r\n        AnswerConditionDTO conditionDTO = new AnswerConditionDTO();\r\n        if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains(&quot;IntegerType&quot;)) {\r\n            IntegerType integerValue = (IntegerType) condition.getValue();\r\n            conditionDTO.setValueInteger(integerValue.getValue());\r\n        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains(&quot;BooleanType&quot;)) {\r\n            BooleanType booleanValue = (BooleanType) condition.getValue();\r\n            conditionDTO.setValueBoolean(booleanValue.getValue());\r\n        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains(&quot;DecimalType&quot;)) {\r\n            DecimalType decimalValue = (DecimalType) condition.getValue();\r\n            conditionDTO.setValueDecimal(decimalValue.getValue().doubleValue());\r\n        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains(&quot;StringType&quot;)) {\r\n            StringType stringValue = (StringType) condition.getValue();\r\n            conditionDTO.setValueString(stringValue.getValue());\r\n        } else if (condition.getValue().getClass().getTypeName().contains(&quot;Coding&quot;)) {\r\n            Coding codingValue = (Coding) condition.getValue();\r\n            conditionDTO.setValueCoding(new CodingDTO(codingValue.getSystem(), codingValue.getCode(), codingValue.getDisplay()));\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        conditionDTO.setOperator(condition.getOperator().getCode());\r\n        conditionDTOs.add(conditionDTO);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    dto.setAnswerConditions(conditionDTOs);\r\n    return dto;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction CodingDTO createFindingCodingFromAnswerSignificance(EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension answerSignificance) {\r\n    CodingDTO finding = new CodingDTO();\r\n    finding.setSystem(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes&quot;);\r\n\r\n    switch (answerSignificance.getSignificance().getCode()) {\r\n        case &quot;green&quot;:\r\n            finding.setCode(&quot;green-question-answer&quot;);\r\n            finding.setDisplay(&quot;green question and answer combination&quot;);\r\n            break;\r\n        case &quot;yellow&quot;:\r\n            finding.setCode(&quot;yellow-question-answer&quot;);\r\n            finding.setDisplay(&quot;yellow question and answer combination&quot;);\r\n            break;\r\n        case &quot;red&quot;:\r\n            finding.setCode(&quot;red-question-answer&quot;);\r\n            finding.setDisplay(&quot;red question and answer combination&quot;);\r\n            break;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    return finding;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO createFindingBasisDTO(String linkId, CodingDTO findingCoding, QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent answer, AnswerSignificanceDTO answerSignificanceDTO) {\r\n    QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO findingBasisDTO = new QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO();\r\n    findingBasisDTO.setLinkId(linkId);\r\n    findingBasisDTO.setFinding(findingCoding);\r\n    findingBasisDTO.setAnswerSignificance(answerSignificanceDTO);\r\n\r\n    if (answer.hasValueBooleanType()) {\r\n        findingBasisDTO.setValueBoolean(answer.getValueBooleanType().booleanValue());\r\n    } else if (answer.hasValueIntegerType()) {\r\n        findingBasisDTO.setValueInteger(answer.getValueIntegerType().getValue());\r\n    } else if (answer.hasValueStringType()) {\r\n        findingBasisDTO.setValueString(answer.getValueStringType().getValueAsString());\r\n    } else if (answer.hasValueDecimalType()) {\r\n        findingBasisDTO.setValueDecimal(answer.getValueDecimalType().getValue().doubleValue());\r\n    } else if (answer.hasValueCoding()) {\r\n        findingBasisDTO.setValueCoding(new CodingDTO(answer.getValueCoding().getSystem(), answer.getValueCoding().getCode(), answer.getValueCoding().getDisplay()));\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    return findingBasisDTO;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction List getFindingBasisList(MultiValuedMap answerSignificanceMap, MultiValuedMap answerMap) {\r\n    ArrayList&lt;QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO&gt; returnList = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();\r\n\r\n    for (Object entry : answerSignificanceMap.entries()) {\r\n        Map.Entry&lt;String, EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension&gt; questionEntry = (Map.Entry&lt;String, EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension&gt;) entry;\r\n        List&lt;QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent&gt; answers = (List&lt;QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent&gt;) answerMap.get(questionEntry.getKey());\r\n\r\n        if (containsExistsFalseCondition(questionEntry.getValue())) {\r\n            //Exists false is special case, where we cant loop through answers\r\n            if (!answers.isEmpty()) {\r\n                continue;\r\n            }\r\n            returnList.add(new QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO(questionEntry.getKey(), createFindingCodingFromAnswerSignificance(questionEntry.getValue()), createAnswerSignificanceFromExtension(questionEntry.getValue())));\r\n        } else {\r\n            //Other operator cases - loop through answers and check against conditions\r\n            for (QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent answer : answers) {\r\n                if (QuestionnaireUtility.compareAnswerAgainstAnswerSignificance(answer, questionEntry.getValue())) {\r\n                    AnswerSignificanceDTO answerSignificanceDTO = createAnswerSignificanceFromExtension(questionEntry.getValue());\r\n                    CodingDTO findingCoding = createFindingCodingFromAnswerSignificance(questionEntry.getValue());\r\n                    returnList.add(createFindingBasisDTO(questionEntry.getKey(), findingCoding, answer, answerSignificanceDTO));\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n    return returnList;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction void gatherLinkedAnswerSignificances(List items, MultiValuedMap answerSignificanceMap) {\r\n    for (Object item : items) {\r\n        List&lt;EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension&gt; answerSignificances = EHealthQuestionnaireItemComponentExtension.getAnswerSignificance(((Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemComponent) item));\r\n        if (answerSignificances != null) {\r\n            answerSignificanceMap.putAll(((Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemComponent) item).getLinkId(), answerSignificances);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        gatherLinkedAnswerSignificances(((Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemComponent) item).getItem(), answerSignificanceMap);\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction void gatherLinkedAnswerItems(List items, MultiValuedMap answerMap) {\r\n    for (Object item : items) {\r\n        List&lt;QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent&gt; answers = ((QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemComponent) item).getAnswer();\r\n        if (answers != null) {\r\n            answerMap.putAll(((QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemComponent) item).getLinkId(), answers);\r\n            for (QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent answer : answers) {\r\n                //Answers have nested items\r\n                gatherLinkedAnswerItems(answer.getItem(), answerMap);\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        //Items have nested items\r\n        gatherLinkedAnswerItems(((QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemComponent) item).getItem(), answerMap);\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction ClinicalImpressionDTO createClinicalImpression(String description, CodingDTO clinicalImpressionFinding, String priority, List basisFindings) {\r\n    CodingDTO clinicalImpressionCode = new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-codes&quot;, &quot;TriagingResult&quot;, &quot;Result of triaging&quot;);\r\n    ClinicalImpressionDTO clinicalImpressionDTO = new ClinicalImpressionDTO(clinicalImpressionCode, description, Collections.singletonList(clinicalImpressionFinding), List.of());\r\n    clinicalImpressionDTO.setFindingBasis(basisFindings);\r\n\r\n    //Determine if triage happened\r\n    boolean isResponseTriaged = true;\r\n    if (clinicalImpressionFinding.getCode().equals(&quot;no-effective-answer-significance&quot;) || clinicalImpressionFinding.getCode().equals(&quot;no-answer-significance-defined&quot;)) {\r\n        isResponseTriaged = false;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //Task\r\n    CodingDTO taskCategory;\r\n    if (isResponseTriaged) {\r\n        taskCategory = new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/task-category&quot;, &quot;MeasurementForAssessment&quot;, &quot;Need assessment of measurement&quot;);\r\n    } else {\r\n        taskCategory = new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/task-category&quot;, &quot;MeasurementForAssessmentNotTriaged&quot;, &quot;Need assessment of measurement where triage was not performed during automated processing&quot;);\r\n    }\r\n    CodingDTO restrictionCategory = new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/restriction-category&quot;, &quot;measurement-monitoring&quot;, &quot;Monitoring of measurement(s)&quot;);\r\n    TaskDTO task = new TaskDTO(taskCategory, &quot;Spørgeskemabesvarelse til evaluering&quot;, priority, Collections.singletonList(restrictionCategory), Collections.emptyList());\r\n    clinicalImpressionDTO.setTasks(Collections.singletonList(task));\r\n\r\n    return clinicalImpressionDTO;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction void throwMismatchedInputException(String ruleDescription, String focus) {\r\n    throw new MismatchedInputException(ruleDescription, focus);\r\n}\r\n\r\nrule &quot;QuestionnaireResponseTriageOnAnswerSignificance&quot;\r\ndialect &quot;java&quot;\r\n    when\r\n        $qrs : Collection()\r\n        $listQrs : ArrayList() from collect (QuestionnaireResponse() from $qrs)\r\n        $questionnaire : Questionnaire()\r\n        $serviceRequest : ServiceRequest()\r\n    then\r\n        if ($listQrs.isEmpty()) {\r\n            throwMismatchedInputException(&quot;Manglende input. Forventede én spørgeskemabesvarelse&quot;, $serviceRequest.getId());\r\n        }\r\n        if ($listQrs.size() &gt; 1) {\r\n            throwMismatchedInputException(&quot;Flere input. Forventede én spørgeskemabesvarelse&quot;, $serviceRequest.getId());\r\n        }\r\n        QuestionnaireResponse qr = (QuestionnaireResponse)$listQrs.get(0);\r\n\r\n        MultiValuedMap&lt;String, EHealthQuestionnaireAnswerSignificanceExtension&gt; answerSignificanceMap = new ArrayListValuedHashMap&lt;&gt;();\r\n        MultiValuedMap&lt;String, QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseItemAnswerComponent&gt; answerMap = new ArrayListValuedHashMap&lt;&gt;();\r\n        gatherLinkedAnswerSignificances($questionnaire.getItem(), answerSignificanceMap);\r\n        gatherLinkedAnswerItems(qr.getItem(), answerMap);\r\n\r\n        CodingDTO clinicalImpressionFinding;\r\n        List&lt;QuestionnaireResponseFindingBasisDTO&gt; findingBasisList = Collections.emptyList();\r\n\r\n        if (answerSignificanceMap.isEmpty() || answerSignificanceMap.values().isEmpty()) {\r\n            clinicalImpressionFinding = new CodingDTO(&quot;http://ehealth.sundhed.dk/cs/clinicalimpression-finding-codes&quot;, &quot;no-answer-significance-defined&quot;, &quot;no answer significance defined for question(s)&quot;);\r\n        } else {\r\n            findingBasisList = getFindingBasisList(answerSignificanceMap, answerMap);\r\n            clinicalImpressionFinding = getClinicalImpressionFinding(findingBasisList);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        String priority = getPriorityFromClinicalFinding(clinicalImpressionFinding);\r\n        ruleResult.setClinicalImpressions(Collections.singletonList(createClinicalImpression(null, clinicalImpressionFinding, priority, findingBasisList)));\r\nend;</code></pre></td></tr>\n            </table>\n          </td>\n        </tr>\n        \n        \n        \n    </table>\n</div>\n</div>"
